title: ideal-cnt-cb-network: Stochastic ideal-network reference generator for CNT/CB polymer composites
description:
Parameter-driven Monte Carlo generator that computes the ideal-network percolation threshold, Simmons-weighted conductivity, and piezoresistive gauge-factor response of CNT/CB polymer composites, reporting each quantity as an ensemble mean with dispersion.

This deposit archives version 1.0.0, released at publication of the paper "A stochastic ideal-network reference for CNT/CB polymer composites: Diagnosing departures in percolation, conductivity, and piezoresistive response" (M. Karabal, A. Yıldız), Computational Materials Science 275 (2026) 115084, https://doi.org/10.1016/j.commatsci.2026.115084. The computational code is identical to version 0.1.0 (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21382449), the code version underlying the paper; version 1.0.0 adds the published article reference to the citation metadata.

The repository includes the source code (percolation, conductivity, and gauge-factor engines), reference output tables, and reproduction wrappers used to generate every figure and table in the paper.
